drafts.title: $4.23 Grand Junction gas vs my cents per mile
drafts.body:
$4.23 a gallon. That's Grand Junction's AAA average today.

My Model Y is a few cents a mile at home. Gas at 30 mpg is about $141 per 1,000 miles.

Which number would you rather live with?
bullets: AAA metro average for Grand Junction (CO only), Nov 7, 2026: regular $4.23/gal (midgrade $4.58, premium $4.93, diesel $6.45).
Down about 3.2% vs last week ($4.38); up about 42% vs a year ago ($2.98); GJ about $0.17 above CO state average $4.07.
At $4.23 and 30 mpg, 1,000 gas miles is about $141; home EV charging is usually a few cents per mile.

drafts.title: Most people want AI to freeze a bad charge before it spends their money
drafts.angle: Protect first, spend later. Kitchen-table trust line for older households. Soft on scam stats already used in Medicare OE draft.
bullets: FIS Consumer Pulse Survey (Nov 5, 2026; n=2,000): 57% comfortable with AI flagging/freezing a suspicious charge without asking first.
50% want to approve every transaction an AI assistant makes; 58% want refund guarantee; 56% want human override.
61% of millennials vs 3% of adults 70+ ready to hand day-to-day money management to AI.
drafts.body:
57%. That's how many adults in a new FIS survey are fine with AI freezing a suspicious charge on its own.

Half still want to approve every spend an AI assistant tries. Refund guarantee and a human who can override were the top trust asks. Control stays with the person.

Only 3% of people 70+ want AI running their day-to-day money. Protect first, spend later.

Would you turn that freeze on for Mom's card?
